integrity: Direct mathematical proof and finite reproducibility checks; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: The Blaschke-type sampling divergence is sufficient, not necessary; logarithmic coefficient is not claimed optimal.
No complete criterion for arbitrary eigenvalue sets, no convergence rates, and no statement for p outside (1,2).
Historical priority may be affected by unindexed complex Müntz and spectral synthesis literature.
title: Logarithmic spectral sampling and arithmetic noncompleteness for crescent Cesàro eigenvectors
